Istanbul - Rumelifeneri
Koç University was founded in 1993 by the Vehbi Koç Foundation with the vision of achieving excellence in education, pioneering scientific research, and contributing value to society. Ranked among the top 500 universities globally, our university is one of Turkey’s most prestigious institutions and aims to contribute to scientific, technological, and societal progress with its research-oriented structure. We offer an inspiring and dynamic living environment on our campus, creating a distinctive working atmosphere.
At Koç University, our employees advance their careers in a dynamic and supportive work environment as part of a team of experts and innovators. Our workplace fosters continuous learning and offers opportunities for personal and professional development. With our vision and strong values, we invite you to join the Koç University family to achieve new milestones in your career.
We are looking for a
Research Engineer
to join the
Koç University İş Bank Artificial Intelligence Research Center (KUIS AI)
of our university who meets the following criteria:
Qualifications
• BS, MS, or PhD degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or a related department from a reputable university
• Strong algorithmic thinking and computational skills in AI/ML/DL
• Proficiency in Python and experience with deep learning frameworks
• Proven experience through an MS/PhD degree or work experience in at least one of the following areas: computer vision, language models, and/or data science
• Strong teamwork and communication skills
• Proficiency in C, C++, or Java is a plus
Job Description
• Work with the Directorate Office and AI faculty members to support academic and industrial projects of KUIS AI
• Contribute to the preparation of research proposals to be submitted to national and international funding agencies
• Interact with industrial partners to understand their needs and priorities
• Research, implement, and optimize state-of-the-art solutions in AI/ML/DL
• Provide technical and software development support
• Attend meetings, technical events, and brainstorming sessions
• Undertake technical and educational tasks of the Center
Koç University embraces the principle of equal opportunities. All candidates are evaluated without discrimination based on race, gender, national or social origin, religion, age, disability, sexual orientation, or marital status.
